rationale: The candidate is visually energetic but not yet program-legible as a gymnasium. Across the four views it reads as a compact, faceted, radially repeated mass with strong topography but weak long-span clarity. The section does not convincingly express a gym hall, daylight roof, or subordinate service bar; instead the form suggests an abstract folded object with colliding and over-faceted surfaces. The top view is especially problematic because the plan reads as a dense polygonal cluster rather than one clear hall organized around an entry/public void. There is also no strong public ground response to an access edge. Compared with the references, it has some resonance with sports-campus aggregation and roofed court logic, but it misses the dominant hall/void hierarchy that the program requires.
